annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国土交通省 (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, Japan)
key_provisions_or_claims: Railway operators must set implementation standards, notify the regional transport bureau, and follow MLIT notices.
Trains must have a driver unless facilities and vehicle structure ensure safe operation without one.
Article 58 sets criteria for automatic train operation devices on railways without a driver on board, including checking passenger safety before departure.
Continuous automatic train deceleration and stopping devices are required for train spacing.
Operators must train staff and verify their aptitude before they do operation-related work.
annotation.summary_en: Japanese Ministerial Ordinance setting technical standards for railways, covering track, stations, electrical systems, signalling, vehicles, and operation. It includes a provision on automatic train operation devices for driverless railways. This text is the version amended in March 2026, effective 1 July 2026.
annotation.title_clean: 鉄道に関する技術上の基準を定める省令
annotation.title_en: Ministerial Ordinance Establishing Technical Standards for Railways
